card.description:
Overview:

**Maple Heights Behavioral Health Hospital** | **Onsite in Fort Wayne, Indiana**

Join Maple Heights Behavioral Health Hospital, a modern 120-bed behavioral health hospital serving adolescents, adults, and seniors in Fort Wayne, Indiana. Our purpose-built campus provides a full continuum of behavioral healthcare services, including inpatient treatment, partial hospitalization (PHP), and intensive outpatient programming (IOP), all delivered in a safe, therapeutic, and patient-centered environment.

As the Director of Facility Operations, you will oversee the physical plant, facilities maintenance, safety, security, environmental services, and regulatory compliance across our approximately 80,000-square-foot hospital campus. This leadership role is critical to ensuring a safe, efficient, and welcoming environment for patients, visitors, and staff while supporting the hospital's mission of delivering exceptional behavioral healthcare.

**PURPOSE STATEMENT:**

Responsible for the overall maintenance of the buildings, grounds, fixtures, and equipment of the facility. Areas of responsibility may include two or more of the following areas/departments: safety, security, maintenance, facilities, materials management, and housekeeping.

Responsibilities:

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Oversee general building maintenance including plumbing, carpentry, painting, roofing, minor repairs, and electrical work.
* Ensure preventative maintenance is completed on all equipment.
* Ensure the facility is in a sanitary, attractive, safe, orderly condition and in compliance with all regulatory standards and accreditation requirements.
* Ensure the facility maintains compliance with all regulatory standards (i.e., NFPA, OSHA, etc.) and accreditation requirements (i.e., CMS, TJC, etc).
* Provide staff management including hiring, development, training, performance management, and communication to ensure effective and efficient department operation.
* Ensure proper operations and maintenance of water systems, emergency electrical systems, sewage systems, primary electrical systems, telephone systems, fire alarm systems, and heating and cooling systems.
* Develop facility maintenance plans, timetables for completion ,and recommendations for maintenance projects.
* Serve as project manager for small-scale, short-duration projects.
* Respond to facility fire and disaster situations immediately and assist per emergency plans.
* Coordinate outside service vendors/contractors and maintenance staff to complete projects as assigned/necessary.

**OTHER FUNCTIONS:**

* Perform other functions and tasks as assigned.

 
Qualifications:

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS**

* High School Diploma required.

Bachelor’s degree or higher level of education in Business or technical field preferred.

* Five or more years’ of Healthcare experience involving construction/maintenance preferred.
* Ten or more years’ construction/maintenance/Healthcare supervisory experience preferred.

**LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Valid state driver's license, where required in a facility.
* CPR and de-escalation/restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
* First aid may be required based on state or facility.
* Valid Certified Healthcare Facility Manager (CHFM) will be preffered.

**ADDITIONAL REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS:**

While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the requirements of the job, management reserves the right to add or remove duties from particular jobs when circumstances (e.g. emergencies, changes in workload, rush jobs or technological developments) dictate.

card.title: Director, Strategy & Operations
card.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including **New York-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit**—collaborate with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Role**

Amae Health is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented **Director of Growth & Operations** to lead market expansion and operational performance across our care delivery ecosystem. This leader will sit at the intersection of market growth, community partnerships, and operational excellence. This role is based in SF Bay Area, in-person 5 days/week in Cow Hollow.

**What You'll Work On**

* Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve day-to-day care delivery: new market launches, care model design, referral conversion, and operational scalability
* Build and implement market playbooks, workflows, and performance frameworks that enable consistent execution across locations
* Use data and frontline feedback to identify bottlenecks, then build and drive improvement initiatives with clear owners and measurable outcomes
* Lead cross-functional workstreams across clinical, ops, and product; manage alignment, communication, and rollout
* Build the systems and SOPs that turn one-off solutions into scalable standards

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in strategy, operations, or growth roles at a venture-backed startup, consulting firm, or healthcare company
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence clinical and executive stakeholders
* Experience in commercially-oriented work: market expansion, partnership operations, or growth initiatives
* Strong analytical and operational mindset with ability to translate strategy into execution
* Startup experience strongly preferred—you've navigated ambiguity and figured things out without a playbook
* Collaborative and high-EQ; you know how to move cross-functional teams without formal authority
* Interest in healthcare or behavioral health; you care about the mission
* Based in SF Bay Area; able to work in-person 5 days/week in Cow Hollow

**What We're Building**

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

* A national care model designed for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.
* Precision medicine for severe mental illness, using multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data to personalize treatment.
* A clinical operating system that integrates longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer.
* New science and measurement frameworks to define what real outcomes look like in SMI.
* A health-system partnership model proving coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. **Base salary range for this role is $165,000–$200,000 per year**, adjusted to market cost; the compensation package may include equity. Total compensation includes comprehensive medical/dental/vision, unlimited PTO, parental leave, and programs built around employee well-being. We'll share specifics during the interview process.

*Amae Health is building the care platform, the precision medicine, and the frontier science that severe mental illness has never had. If you want to be part of creating something this hard and this important, something that has never been done, we'd like to talk.*

**What We Value**

* **We center care in all we do.** Empathy is not a brand value. It's how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.
* **We challenge convention.** The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.
* **We take the work seriously, not ourselves.** High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.
* **Your job isn't done until the job is done.** We close gaps, we follow through, and we don't hide behind titles or org charts.
* **We win together and fail together.** We own outcomes as a team. We learn fast. We don't do blame.
* **We hustle with humility.** Speed matters. So does integrity. We assume best intent and stay grounded in the mission.

card.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

As our **Director of Destination Care Operations**, you will serve as the strategic leader for our high-acuity patient programs, driving operational excellence for patients traveling from across the U.S. and international markets for specialty care. You will oversee the end-to-end patient journey, ensuring a concierge-caliber experience from the initial inquiry through to post-discharge. By partnering with clinical leadership, financial stakeholders, and external partners, you will optimize workflows and grow referral volumes, positioning our facility as a premier destination for complex medical services.

Every day you will lead a high-performing team by fostering a culture of service excellence, adaptability, and continuous improvement. Your focus will be on the seamless integration of intake, registration, and financial counseling workflows, ensuring both operational efficiency and fiscal responsibility. You will conduct regular patient and family rounding to identify service gaps, implement process improvements, and provide hands-on leadership as the escalation point for complex, time-sensitive patient matters, all while maintaining rigorous data integrity and reporting standards.

To be successful in this role, you will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field, accompanied by at least 5 years of progressive leadership experience within a complex, matrixed healthcare environment. You must demonstrate a proven track record in managing destination care, specialty referral, or international patient service programs. We are looking for an adaptable leader with strong process improvement skills, the ability to influence without direct authority, and a deep commitment to delivering culturally informed, high-touch care to diverse patient populations.

* Oversees the day-to-day operational performance of the destination care program, ensuring consistent and high quality service delivery across all phases of the patient journey. Oversees referral intake and coordination workflows, ensuring timely and accurate routing, follow-up, and communication with referring providers and patients.
* Ensures patients, families, and referring partners experience seamless, concierge-caliber service from initial contact through post-discharge follow-up; conducts regular patient and family rounding to assess experience, identify service gaps and recovery opportunities, reinforce service standards, and gather patient stories that reflect the destination care experience.
* Delivers and ensures culturally informed service, communication, and care coordination across diverse domestic and international patient populations. Partners with clinical leadership and clinical advisory resources to support patient care operations and ensure the clinical needs of the destination care population are addressed. Identifies and leads process improvement and workflow optimization initiatives to advance operational efficiency, service quality, and patient satisfaction; develops and maintains operational protocols and standards that support consistent program delivery.
* Supports the development and expansion of the destination care program, including identifying opportunities to grow referral volume, expand service line access, and strengthen the program’s market position. Supports market activation and outreach efforts in collaboration with strategy partners to advance destination care program visibility and referral growth; performs other duties as assigned to support organizational objectives.

 **Job Requirements**

**Minimum**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field, and

In this role, the Director of Program Operations leads a team of Operations Program Managers (OPM) and Material Program Managers (MPM) responsible for the operational elements of program execution within Mercury's IPS business unit. The Director of Program Operations will support proposals by providing accurate basis of cost estimates, focusing on supply chain material costs in addition to manufacturing labor costs. * Responsible for meeting the financial objectives of the business unit, including the management of Estimate at Completion (EACs) specific to operations labor and material content.
* Oversee supply chain and manufacturing milestones to ensure compliance with contract baseline.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
AFC Industries is a dynamic organization dedicated to providing supply chain management solutions for fasteners and assembly components to original equipment manufacturers, assembly plants, and other users of these products.

We support a diverse industry base of manufacturers across a broad range of industries. Our experienced team has a proven track record of helping manufacturers and assemblers reduce cost, improve quality, and increase efficiency.

We are A Company Culture Devoted to Innovation & Improvement

AFC provides localized expertise to customers in particular industries and geographies. We don't have a traditional hierarchical management structure where everyone simply "reports up." Instead, our company is made up of on-the-ground experts operating in an entrepreneurial fashion with the backing and support of an enterprise-grade organization.

Sharing cultural values breeds consistency and quality throughout our organization. Collectively, we are committed to a simple management approach, which influences our company culture and our management style.

**Reports to:** Vice President of Operations

**Position Summary**

AFC North America is seeking a seasoned Director of Operations to lead our large regional distribution centers, which supply a network of localized service centers and the customers they support. This leader will execute the operational strategy for the DCs, drive discipline of the operational fundamentals, and build a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement. Although the service hubs operate under separate leadership, this role is accountable for ensuring the DCs deliver the service levels the hubs need to support their customers. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of running high-volume distribution operations, using data to make decisions, and partnering across the organization to deliver measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership and DC Performance**

* Provide strategic and day-to-day leadership for the distribution centers, ensuring reliable, efficient, and cost-effective flow of product to the service hub network.
* Establish and reinforce operational fundamentals (standard work, process discipline, accountability, and leader standard work) across all DC operations.
* Treat the service hubs as internal customers: align DC service levels, cutoff times, and replenishment performance to hub and end-customer requirements.
* Involvement of operational integration of acquired distribution facilities, bringing them onto common standards, systems, and KPIs.

**Labor Planning and Workforce Management**

* Own labor forecasting and capacity planning using volume forecasts, productivity standards, and seasonal trends to right-size staffing across shifts and sites.
* Develop engineered labor standards and productivity models that improve labor utilization and control overtime and temporary labor spend.
* Build leadership bench strength through coaching, succession planning, and development of DC managers and supervisors.

**Performance Metrics and Financial Accountability**

* Define, implement, and manage a balanced KPI framework covering safety, quality, service, productivity, and cost (e.g., OSHA recordables, order accuracy, on-time and complete shipments to service hubs, units per labor hour, cost per unit).
* Lead operational reviews with clear scorecards, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans.
* Own the DC operations budget, partner with Finance on forecasting and variance analysis, and identify opportunities to reduce cost-to-serve.

**Efficiency and Continuous Improvement**

* Champion Lean, Six Sigma, and related methodologies to eliminate waste, improve throughput, and optimize space, layout, and material flow.
* Lead major operational initiatives, including DC expansions, consolidations, network redesigns, and new program implementations.

**Safety and Quality**

* Set the standard for a zero-harm safety culture; ensure compliance with OSHA, DOT, and company policies across DC and fleet operations.
* Facility maintenance: provide guidance regarding facility repairs and maintenance according to lease terms.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with service hub leadership to define service expectations, share performance data, and resolve issues that affect downstream customers.
* Work with Sales, Customer Service, Procurement, Inventory Planning, Finance, HR, and IT to align DC capabilities with business priorities.
* Serve as the operational voice in strategic planning, translating business goals into executable DC operating plans.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive operations leadership in distribution, warehousing, or logistics, including significant experience at the director or senior manager level.
* Demonstrated success leading large, high-volume distribution centers that supply a multi-site or hub-and-spoke network.
* Strong expertise in labor forecasting, capacity planning, and productivity management.
* Proven ability to build and manage KPI frameworks and deliver measurable improvements in safety, quality, service, and cost.
* Hands-on experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, TOC, or Toyota Production System principles.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting.
* Proficiency with WMS, labor management systems, and data and reporting tools.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and change management skills, with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA preferred.
* Ability to travel as required between DC locations.

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

*We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer.*

Description:

**Job Title:** Director of Campus Operations

**Department:** Facilities

**Reports To:** Executive Director of Administration

**Direct Reports:** Assistant Director of Campus Operations

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Prepared By:** Human Resources

**Prepared Date:** November 11, 2026

**OUR MISSION**

The mission of Eastern Star Church is to form followers of Jesus to love God, love people, and live to serve. Guided by our vision of Growing People to Love Like Jesus, we are committed to creating environments that support worship, discipleship, community engagement, and service.

**YOUR ROLE IN OUR MISSION**

Under the direction of the Executive Director of Administration, the **Director of Campus Operations** provides strategic leadership, oversight, and accountability for campus operations and facilities across Eastern Star Church and its affiliated organizations, including JEWEL Human Services.

This role is responsible for establishing operational standards, ensuring effective stewardship of facilities and resources, and leading the development and performance of the operations team. Through direct supervision of the Assistant Director of Operations and other assigned leaders, the Director ensures that campus operations are safe, efficient, consistent, and aligned with organizational priorities.

The Director serves as a key partner in advancing the ministry’s mission and strategic plan by ensuring that our facilities and physical environments support worship, discipleship, community outreach, and an exceptional experience for all who enter. The position emphasizes strategic planning, leadership development, financial accountability, and continuous improvement while delegating day-to-day operational execution to the Assistant Director of Operations.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide strategic leadership, direction, and oversight for campus operations and facilities across Eastern Star Church and its affiliated properties, under the direction of the Executive Director of Administration.
* Establish operational standards and performance expectations to ensure all facilities are safe, functional, well-maintained, and reflective of a culture of excellence and stewardship, holding the Assistant Director of Operations accountable for daily implementation.
* Develop and recommend long-term facilities strategies, including capital improvements, renovations, and expansion planning, in alignment with organizational priorities and the direction of the Executive Director of Administration.
* Provide leadership and oversight for facilities-related capital projects, ensuring appropriate planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and accountability for successful completion within approved timelines and budgets.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Assistant Director of Operations and other assigned direct reports, establishing clear expectations, delegated responsibilities, performance measures, and opportunities for professional growth.
* Establish and maintain consistent operational policies, facility standards, and accountability measures across all campuses and affiliated properties, ensuring effective implementation through the Assistant Director of Operations.
* Partner with executive leadership, Campus Pastors, ministry leaders, and production and creative teams to align campus operations, facility resources, and operational priorities with worship services, programs, events, and organizational needs.
* Provide strategic oversight of vendor relationships, contracts, and service providers, ensuring quality, compliance, cost-effectiveness, and accountability, while delegating routine vendor coordination and service management to the Assistant Director of Operations.
* Develop, manage, and monitor facilities and operations budgets in partnership with Finance and the Executive Director of Administration, ensuring responsible stewardship of resources, financial accountability, and timely identification of budget variances.
* Establish and oversee safety, security, emergency preparedness, and risk management standards, ensuring regulatory compliance and holding operational leadership accountable for implementing and maintaining required procedures.
* Lead the development and continuous improvement of operational systems, processes, technology, and workflows that strengthen efficiency, consistency, communication, and accountability across all campus operations.
* Establish campus experience and operational readiness standards to ensure facilities consistently provide safe, welcoming, functional, and well-prepared environments that support ministry effectiveness and reflect the mission of Eastern Star Church.
* Establish and monitor departmental performance goals and key performance indicators, evaluating operational effectiveness, preventive maintenance performance, campus readiness, service delivery, and resource utilization.
* Provide regular operational reports to the Executive Director of Administration, including departmental performance, budget status, capital project progress, operational risks, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with the Executive Director of Administration to establish departmental priorities, evaluate organizational needs, recommend resource allocations, and support the implementation of organizational strategic initiatives.
* Carry out all responsibilities with excellence, integrity, trust, professionalism, and the utmost confidentiality.

Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated alignment with the mission, vision, and values of the ministry.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale operations and facilities across multiple sites.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence across departments.
* Active member of Eastern Star Church within three months of starting in the role
* Attend at least one weekly Sunday service.
* Active in a Ministry within three months of starting in the role.
* Complete FFI 101 series or is currently enrolled in class.
* Consistent giver as an opportunity to show God Owns It All by giving back to Him the first of what He gives to us.
* Please refer to the Eastern Star Church Discipleship Policy for additional details.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of leadership experience in operations, facilities, or multi-site management
* Experience leading large-scale projects, capital improvements, renovations, multi-site operations and vendor relationships.
* Strong financial and budget management experience.
* A combination of relevant experience and demonstrated leadership may be considered in place of formal education requirements.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS**

* Relevant facilities, operations, or project management certifications (preferred but not required).

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

card.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Vice President, Final Control Operations will provide overall leadership for Final Control Operations including valve field and shop testing and repair, production (new valve assembly) and valve inventory management. Responsibilities include developing and implementing strategies to enhance safety, quality, efficiency, and service levels through managing a team of Directors and Managers responsible for 100+ employees in 6 locations in the Southeast US. The role involves driving continuous improvement projects, ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards, and managing supply chain and inventory. Financial management, including budget development and cost control is essential to the success of this position. The role serves on the Control Southern Executive Leadership Team.

#### **Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for daily operations and implementing companywide operational strategies with a focus on financial growth, service levels and customer satisfaction.
* Active participation and collaboration on Company Leadership Team and Strategic Council.
* Interview, hire, train and mentor a team of Directors/Managers.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop and implement short-term and long-term strategies, structure, and process to achieve business results.
* Oversee planning, execution, and delivery for production/new valve assembly and services.
* Ensure quality control and compliance with industry standards.
* Provide weekly operational performance updates to the Executive Leadership Team.
* Maintain an exceptional and well communicated Safety Program.
* Oversight of warehouse operations including shipping & receiving, supply chain and inventory management.
* Develop, manage and achieve the annual operations budget and capital investment plan.
* Collaborate with other Operations Leaders from the Emerson Impact Partner Network.

#### **Other Duties:**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

#### **Physical Demands:**

* Periodic visits to company operation centers and customer facilities or project sites, which require adherence to safety protocols and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Typical facilities include Commercial Power Plants, Nuclear Plants, Pulp and Paper Mills, Chemical Plants, Manufacturing Plants, etc.
* Regular use of a computer, which may involve repetitive motion such as typing.
* Frequent use of the phone for communication with team members, stakeholders, and clients.

#### **Travel:**

* Overnight travel required to company operations centers currently in Chattanooga, TN; Decatur, AL; Jacksonville, FL; Lakeland, FL; Macon, GA, and Suwanee, GA
* Must be willing for overnight travels to work on site at customer
* Overnight travel may be required to attend factory and/or customer meetings as necessary.
* 50%+ travel depending on office location may be required.

#### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or industrial engineering; MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in operations management in manufacturing; experience in the valve or mechanical services industry preferred.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Knowledge of valve technology and assembly processes.
* Experience with lean manufacturing and project management.
* High Emotional Quotient for leading others.
* Experience leading Safety & Quality Programs.
* Strategic Inventory Optimization experience a plus.
* Strong financial acumen and analytical skills.

**About Control Southern**

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in Suwanee, Georgia, Control Southern is an integrated solutions provider that helps manufacturing plants across the Southeast run better, faster and smarter through automation and customized valve solutions. As an Emerson Impact Partner, we are the local point of contact for sales, service and applied engineering for Emerson's automation solutions in Georgia, Florida, East Tennessee and North Alabama. We are employee-owned through our ESOP, and our culture is grounded in our motto: ***When integrity leads, success follows.***

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

**J****ob Title:** Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Operations

**Group:** Information Technology

**Location:** Hybrid

**Reports To**: Chief Information Officer

ASME is seeking a **Sr. Director, Infrastructure and Operations** to join our IT group. The Sr. Director will lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations of ASME's infrastructure, telecommunications, networks, help desk, and related security capabilities.

This role will ensure secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology services while advancing DevOps practices, business continuity, disaster recovery, and responsible implementation of artificial intelligence across ASME's technology stack.

The position partners closely with Architecture and Applications, Security, the Project Management Office, and business leaders to support current operations and future enterprise needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and day-to-day operations of ASME infrastructure, cloud, network, telecommunications, endpoint, help desk, and production platforms.
* Lead major infrastructure initiatives, establish policies and standards, strengthen cross-functional and vendor partnerships, and coach and develop a high-performing, customer-focused Technology team.
* Design and implement secure, compliant, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective infrastructure systems that integrate effectively with current applications and meet enterprise requirements.
* Determine current and future infrastructure needs, develop capital and expense budgets, and oversee vendors, service-level agreements, and key performance indicators.
* Build and continuously improve DevOps practices, methodologies, and tools that support continuous integration and continuous delivery.
* Direct business continuity, disaster recovery, institutional risk management, infrastructure documentation, and compliance with applicable security and data requirements, including PCI-DSS.
* Identify and implement emerging AI capabilities for Infrastructure and Operations, including AIOps, AI-enabled platform engineering, AI agents, and automation platforms, with appropriate governance, monitoring, security, lifecycle management, and risk controls.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent additional experience; master's degree is a plus.
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant technical and leadership experience in infrastructure and operations.
* Extensive experience designing, implementing, and managing infrastructure, cloud, network, telecommunications, endpoint, virtualization, storage, recovery, and support environments, including Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with endpoint management and asset lifecycle solutions such as Microsoft Intune, PDQ, or Jamf, and with secure network architecture and protocols such as SASE; Cato experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in security, crisis management, business continuity, disaster recovery, risk management, and technology compliance.
* Experience applying project management frameworks to large-scale technology initiatives and communicating complex technical topics clearly to senior and executive leaders.
* Experience with emerging AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot and private large language models, and the ability to build strong internal and external relationships.
* Proven experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to establish clear standards, strengthen accountability, and build a customer-focused culture of operational excellence.
* Demonstrated success leading organizational change and operational improvement initiatives.

**Work Arrangement**

This role is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement and will be based in either our New York or New Jersey office locations, subject to ASME's hybrid-work policies and business requirements. Periodic business travel will be required, including but not limited to ASME Offices which are currently located in NYC, NJ, DC, TX.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The New York Metro annual base salary range for this position is $210,000–$225,000 per year. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on factors including qualifications, experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity.

This position will also be eligible to participate in ASME's annual incentive bonus program, subject to the applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Additionally, ASME offers eligible employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage; health savings and flexible spending account options; life and disability insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; paid vacation and safe and sick leave; paid holidays; parental leave; employee assistance and wellness programs; and professional-development opportunities. Eligibility and benefit levels vary based on employment status and the terms of the applicable plans. For additional information, please visit ASME's Benefits page.

**About ASME**

ASME helps the global engineering community develop solutions to real-world challenges. Founded in 1880 as The American Society of Mechanical Engineers, ASME is a nonprofit professional organization that enables collaboration, knowledge sharing, and skill development across all engineering disciplines, while promoting the vital role of the engineer in society. ASME codes and standards, publications, conferences, continuing education, and professional development programs provide a foundation for advancing technical knowledge and a safer world. From college students and early-career engineers to project managers, corporate executives, researchers, and academic leaders, ASME's members are as diverse as the engineering community itself.

ASME is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. At ASME, we nurture an inclusive environment, and we encourage, support, and celebrate diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, citizenship status, disability, or protected veteran, military status, or any other basis protected by law.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity policy pertains to every aspect of an individual’s relationship with the organization, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training and development, promotion, programs, and all other terms and conditions of employment.

Only those candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted.

card.description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Operations Manager leads the machining department (approximately 60 employees) through supervisors and technical specialists. The role is accountable for safety, quality, on-time delivery, capacity utilization, productivity, and margins in a high-mix, low-volume precision CNC environment.

This is a people-and-business leadership position focused on removing barriers, driving continuous improvement, and partnering with the General Manager and Business Development to support profitable growth. Hands-on machining or CNC programming is not required.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Safety & Quality: Maintain a safety-first culture. Partner with Quality to uphold ISO standards, reduce nonconformances, and lower cost of poor quality through root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Operational Performance & Capacity: Direct production through supervisors across milling, turning, and secondary operations. Improve throughput by reducing bottlenecks, setup times, downtime, and waste. Optimize capacity planning, staffing, sequencing, and preventive maintenance.
* Delivery & Customer Execution: Own on-time delivery from order release through shipment. Ensure realistic schedules, visible priorities, and proactive recovery plans. Coordinate cross-functionally with Planning, Quality, Purchasing, and Shipping.
* Financial & Margin Management: Partner with Finance and the General Manager to protect and improve gross margin through labor productivity, material yield, scrap reduction, and disciplined cost control. Monitor job costs and provide reliable data for quoting, make/buy decisions, and capital recommendations.
* Systems & Continuous Improvement: Drive adoption, accuracy, and continuous improvement of ERP/MRP and shop-floor systems. Apply Lean tools (5S/6S, standard work, SMED, value-stream mapping, Kaizen) where they deliver measurable results. Develop practical performance dashboards and management reviews.
* People Leadership & Culture: Develop supervisors, team leads, and production personnel through coaching, clear expectations, and empowerment. Build engagement, retention, skills development, and succession. Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Growth Partnership: Support Business Development with capacity assessments, customer meetings, and opportunity qualification to profitably fill available machine capacity.

**Key Performance Measures**

* Safety performance
* On-time delivery and schedule adherence
* Throughput, labor productivity, setup time, and unplanned downtime
* Capacity utilization and available capacity for new work
* Gross margin, job-cost variance, and scrap/rework costs
* ERP/MRP data accuracy and timely reporting
* Employee engagement, retention, and internal development
* Nonconformance trends and cost of quality

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience leading manufacturing teams or operations departments, preferably in CNC machining, high-mix/low-volume contract manufacturing, or precision manufacturing. Hands-on machinist or programming experience is not required.
* Demonstrated improvements in productivity, on-time delivery, profitability, and operational performance, supported by measurable results.
* Experience implementing or improving ERP/MRP systems, production scheduling, job costing, and KPI reporting.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, business acumen, change management, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Practical understanding of capacity, cost drivers, scheduling, Lean methods, and ISO-based quality systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or business preferred; equivalent relevant leadership experience will be considered.

**Role Alignment**

This role manages the machining department through its supervisors and technical staff, with accountability for people development, operational performance, and continuous improvement. The Senior Operations Manager partners with the General Manager on business priorities, financial objectives, and capital recommendations, and with Business Development on customer relationships and growth.

The position does not require personally operating or programming CNC equipment. Final authority for pricing, hiring, capital spending, and related decisions will be defined by company leadership.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

card.title: Sr. Manager, Operations
card.description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior Operations Manager leads the machining department (approximately 60 employees) through supervisors and technical specialists. The role is accountable for safety, quality, on-time delivery, capacity utilization, productivity, and margins in a high-mix, low-volume precision CNC environment.
 
 
This is a people-and-business leadership position focused on removing barriers, driving continuous improvement, and partnering with the General Manager and Business Development to support profitable growth. Hands-on machining or CNC programming is not required.
 
 
**Key Accountabilities**

* Safety & Quality: Maintain a safety-first culture. Partner with Quality to uphold ISO standards, reduce nonconformances, and lower cost of poor quality through root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Operational Performance & Capacity: Direct production through supervisors across milling, turning, and secondary operations. Improve throughput by reducing bottlenecks, setup times, downtime, and waste. Optimize capacity planning, staffing, sequencing, and preventive maintenance.
* Delivery & Customer Execution: Own on-time delivery from order release through shipment. Ensure realistic schedules, visible priorities, and proactive recovery plans. Coordinate cross-functionally with Planning, Quality, Purchasing, and Shipping.
* Financial & Margin Management: Partner with Finance and the General Manager to protect and improve gross margin through labor productivity, material yield, scrap reduction, and disciplined cost control. Monitor job costs and provide reliable data for quoting, make/buy decisions, and capital recommendations.
* Systems & Continuous Improvement: Drive adoption, accuracy, and continuous improvement of ERP/MRP and shop-floor systems. Apply Lean tools (5S/6S, standard work, SMED, value-stream mapping, Kaizen) where they deliver measurable results. Develop practical performance dashboards and management reviews.
* People Leadership & Culture: Develop supervisors, team leads, and production personnel through coaching, clear expectations, and empowerment. Build engagement, retention, skills development, and succession. Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Growth Partnership: Support Business Development with capacity assessments, customer meetings, and opportunity qualification to profitably fill available machine capacity.

**Key Performance Measures**

* Safety performance
* On-time delivery and schedule adherence
* Throughput, labor productivity, setup time, and unplanned downtime
* Capacity utilization and available capacity for new work
* Gross margin, job-cost variance, and scrap/rework costs
* ERP/MRP data accuracy and timely reporting
* Employee engagement, retention, and internal development
* Nonconformance trends and cost of quality

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience leading manufacturing teams or operations departments, preferably in CNC machining, high-mix/low-volume contract manufacturing, or precision manufacturing. Hands-on machinist or programming experience is not required.
* Demonstrated improvements in productivity, on-time delivery, profitability, and operational performance, supported by measurable results.
* Experience implementing or improving ERP/MRP systems, production scheduling, job costing, and KPI reporting.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, business acumen, change management, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Practical understanding of capacity, cost drivers, scheduling, Lean methods, and ISO-based quality systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or business preferred; equivalent relevant leadership experience will be considered.

**Role Alignment**
This role manages the machining department through its supervisors and technical staff, with accountability for people development, operational performance, and continuous improvement. The Senior Operations Manager partners with the General Manager on business priorities, financial objectives, and capital recommendations, and with Business Development on customer relationships and growth.
 
 
The position does not require personally operating or programming CNC equipment. Final authority for pricing, hiring, capital spending, and related decisions will be defined by company leadership.
 
 
**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

This is a key leadership position responsible for driving operational excellence, improving financial performance, developing strong management teams, and ensuring consistency and accountability across all facilities.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader who understands how to manage a multi-location operation, develop General Managers, improve productivity, control costs, and build a culture of performance and accountability.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

**Multi-Plant Leadership**

* Provide overall operational leadership and direction to five commercial laundry facilities.
* Lead, coach, and hold General Managers accountable for facility performance and results.
* Establish consistent operating standards, procedures, and expectations across all locations.
* Conduct regular facility visits to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and address operational challenges.

**Financial and Operational Performance**

* Oversee operational budgets, expenses, labor costs, overtime, and profitability.
* Partner with Finance to monitor financial results, identify variances, and implement corrective actions.
* Drive cost-control initiatives, productivity improvements, and operational efficiencies.
* Ensure each facility meets established financial and operational objectives.

**Production and Productivity**

* Oversee production performance, workflow, scheduling, labor utilization, and capacity planning.
* Monitor productivity, quality, rewash, linen loss, and production efficiency.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to maximize throughput and resource utilization.
* Ensure production operations support customer demand and service commitments.

**Customer Service and Service Delivery**

* Ensure consistent service quality, accuracy, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Service, and Transportation to resolve operational issues.
* Establish accountability for customer complaints, service failures, shortages, and recurring quality concerns.

**Leadership and Employee Development**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate General Managers and key operational leaders.
* Establish clear performance expectations, measurable goals, and accountability standards.
* Address performance concerns and leadership gaps promptly.
* Build a culture of ownership, teamwork, communication, and continuous improvement.

**Maintenance, Engineering, and Safety**

* Partner with Engineering and Maintenance leadership to improve equipment reliability and reduce downtime.
* Support preventive maintenance programs, capital projects, and facility improvements.
* Promote a safe working environment and ensure compliance with applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Human Resources and plant leadership on employee relations, workforce planning, and labor matters.

**Transportation and Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Transportation leadership to improve routing, fleet utilization, delivery performance, and operating efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with Finance, Human Resources, Sales, Engineering, Customer Service, and other departments.
* Provide regular operational updates, performance reports, and recommendations to executive leadership.

* Plant profitability and performance against budget.
* Labor costs, overtime, and productivity.
* Pounds processed per labor hour and production efficiency.
* Customer service, on-time delivery, and quality.
* Rewash, shortages, and linen loss.
* Equipment reliability and downtime.
* Workplace safety and compliance.
* Staffing, employee retention, and General Manager performance.
* Execution of operational improvement initiatives.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive operations management experience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience leading and developing General Managers, Plant Managers, or senior operational leaders.
* Commercial laundry, textile rental, manufacturing, distribution, or other labor-intensive industrial experience strongly preferred.
* Experience managing budgets, analyzing financial results, and improving operational profitability.
* Experience working in a unionized environment and interpreting collective bargaining agreements preferred.

* Strong leadership and people-development skills.
* Ability to lead through others rather than micromanage.
* High level of accountability and the ability to hold others accountable.
* Strong financial and analytical abilities.
* Strategic thinking and sound business judgment.
* Effective communication and relationship-building skills.
* Decisive problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to implement change and drive continuous improvement.

* The employee is responsible for independently arranging reliable transportation to and from all assigned work locations and required reporting locations.
* The employee must be able to report to all assigned locations at the times and schedules required by the position.

card.description:
**Director of Warehouse Operations**

**Your Leadership. Our Foundation.**

At **Cash Depot**, you’re not just joining a company, you’re becoming part of a family.

As a nationwide leader in ATM management and financial transaction processing, we’ve built our reputation on innovation, exceptional customer service, and strong partnerships. As we continue expanding our footprint and evolving our solutions, we’re seeking a strategic, hands-on operations leader to oversee the teams that keep our ATM equipment and components ready to support our customers.

When you join Cash Depot, you’re stepping into an organization where your ideas matter, your leadership is valued, and your impact is visible across the business. This is an opportunity to lead four teams, improve how our operations run, and build a high-performing warehouse organization focused on efficiency, quality, and long-term success.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package
* **Profit Sharing Bonus Program**
* **Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits**
* **Company-paid Life Insurance**
* **Company-paid Short-Term Disability (STD)**
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Monday through Friday daytime schedule
* Leadership visibility with a direct reporting line to the COO
* Opportunity to shape how our operations grow and improve
* Stable, growing organization with nationwide operations

**Position Summary**

The **Director of Warehouse Operations** provides strategic leadership, direction, and oversight for Cash Depot’s Inventory and Warehousing, ATM Parts Repair, ATM Set-Up and Refurbishment, and Purchasing departments.

Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director is accountable for operational efficiency, inventory accuracy, cost management, quality control, productivity, and the timely availability of ATM equipment and components to support company operations and customer commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership & Cost Management**

* Manage departmental budgets and identify opportunities to reduce operating costs.
* Improve productivity and eliminate inefficiencies across warehouse, repair, refurbishment, and purchasing functions.
* Analyze operational data to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.
* Increase throughput, quality, and profitability across all areas of responsibility.

**Inventory, Repair & Equipment Readiness**

* Improve inventory accuracy, availability, and inventory turns.
* Improve repair turnaround times and reduce replacement costs.
* Ensure ATM equipment is set up, refurbished, and deployment-ready on schedule.
* Maintain quality standards that support company operations and customer commitments.

**Purchasing & Vendor Management**

* Improve vendor pricing, procurement efficiency, and cost controls.
* Ensure timely availability of ATM equipment, parts, and components.
* Build productive vendor relationships that support quality and reliability.

**Team Development & Accountability**

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable four department leaders: the Warehouse Manager, Purchasing Manager, Parts Repair Lead, and Setup/Refurb Lead.
* Set clear performance standards and expectations across all four departments.
* Build and foster high-performing teams aligned with Cash Depot’s culture and values.
* Operate within corporate policy guidelines and business practices.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of operations management experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze data and identify operational bottlenecks or opportunities.
* Deep understanding of service delivery principles and customer satisfaction.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or other relevant systems.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong ability to lead and inspire teams.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate with teams, customers, and leadership.
* Results-oriented with a demonstrated sense of urgency.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Ability to adapt to change in the workplace or in assigned duties.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

**Why Cash Depot?**

This is an opportunity to join a growing national organization in a highly visible leadership role. As Director of Warehouse Operations, you’ll lead the teams that keep Cash Depot’s ATM equipment moving, shape how our operations run, and directly influence the service we deliver to customers across the country.

**Join Cash Depot and lead the operations that power our next chapter of growth.**
